title: pi and GLM are the factory's defaults on main, and the factory deploys from main again
description:
OPERATOR, 2026-09-23, same reconciliation. Three layers decide a cloud worker's harness and model, and today they disagree:

  - worker-boot.ts built-in defaults: WORKER_DEFAULT_HARNESS = 'omp', WORKER_DEFAULT_MODEL = 'workers-ai/@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-0813'
  - wrangler.toml RUN_HARNESS / RUN_MODEL / RUN_WORKER_HARNESS / RUN_WORKER_MODEL: unset on main; set to pi + workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 ONLY on the throwaway branch smoke/xte-omp-glm
  - .tick/runners.toml roles and profiles-cloudflare-sandbox (xte): pi + GLM, substrate-aware so nothing in the cloud is claude (84z)

The deployed factory is running smoke/xte-omp-glm right now. That branch is the only reason a cloud run today gets pi and GLM rather than omp and DeepSeek, and it carries unmerged code.

DO: make pi and GLM 5.3 the defaults on main at every layer that has one - the TS constants, and explicit RUN_* pins in wrangler.toml with the operator's rule as the comment (GLM 5.3 / 5.3 Flash via pi only; nothing in the cloud runs claude). Deploy the factory from main and confirm a cloud boot reports harness pi and model glm-5.3 'from the control plane'. Then delete smoke/xte-omp-glm and the throwaway epic plw/pg9 it carries (and epic/plw).

Local stays as it is: the compiled-in profiles/ default (claude) serves laptop runs, which the operator runs on claude by choice.
notes: 2026-09-23 23:15 - ticfac run epic-yoh: attempt 1 reported a finding drafted for triage — defect "Full-suite gate fails in run worktrees: TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo exits 1, not 2" (key 4c8bb360255b112bfd2a35b714dd21d70fcd3ed06d7e38c470e108a65212b626, severity medium, for this repository). Triage with `ticfac finding yoh 4c8bb360255b112bfd2a35b714dd21d70fcd3ed06d7e38c470e108a65212b626 --promote-as <tick> --by "<who>"`, `--discard --by "<who>"`, or — when it was repaired inside this epic — `--fixed-as <commit> --by "<who>"`; the tick closes and the finding rides to the close-out, which does not hand over while it is untriaged.
acceptance_criteria: On main, with no RUN_* override, a cloud worker and orchestrator boot on harness pi and model workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3; the factory is deployed from main and a boot says so; nothing in the TS defaults names omp, DeepSeek or claude for a cloud role; smoke/xte-omp-glm, epic/plw and the plw/pg9 ticks are gone; and the full suites pass
